reasons_add: Al-Ṭabrisī explicitly infers the one-third taking from 'from their wealth' rather than an order to take all of it.
Al-Qurṭubī reports that the command was revealed after someone said the Prophet had not been ordered to take anything from their wealth.
Al-Qurṭubī reports the intervening statement that no order to take their wealth had yet been given before the command was revealed.
